name: NLnet Restack — Nocturnal Open Matter Bundles
deadline_note: Restack first call deadline is November 3, 2026 at 12:00 CET. Reverify the call and GenAI policy before submission.

packet_requirements.description: NLnet first-grant portfolio bakeoff must select Nocturnal before this route is promoted into FIRE.
Applicant must write the actual proposal answers in their own words; the AI-assisted workbook is structure/fact support only.
Applicant must approve exact FLOS/open-access release boundary for funded outputs.
Current NLnet form/policy requires disclosure of AI assistance and relevant prompts/interactions/output. Reverify the latest policy and prepare the required log.

compliance_checks: Do not paste the AI-assisted workbook as if it were applicant-written final prose.
Do not claim a European collaborator/user unless one actually exists.
Do not promise a public/open release until the owner approves the exact release boundary.
Do not hide ChatGPT/GPT-5.6 Sol assistance from the NLnet disclosure.
Do not represent completed Nocturnal UI/product work as new grant-funded work.
